proposal.summary: Unauthenticated SQL injection in WordPress Core WP_Query before 5.8.3 via user-supplied string in query_vars (tax_query terms) allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information, including stored credentials.
proposal.cwe_quote:
The specific flaw exists within the WP_Query class,
The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries,

AV.quote: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of WordPress Core,

AC.quote: The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries,

PR.quote: Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability,

S.quote: The specific flaw exists within the WP_Query class,

C.quote: An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain and review the referenced ZDI and HackerOne advisories and vendor release notes to reproduce the issue and verify fixes; if confirmed, coordinate disclosure and recommend updating affected WordPress installations to 5.8.3 or later.
